## Summary: Triple-Axis Spectrometer (TAS) Instrument

I have successfully rebuilt and validated the TAS instrument from the provided specification. Here is a complete report:

### **Instrument Architecture**

The instrument consists of the following components in beam order:

1. **Progress_bar** (Origin) - Simulation progress indicator
2. **Source_gen** (Source) - Thermal neutron source with Maxwellian distributions
3. **L_monitor** (L_mon_source) - Wavelength monitor after source (diagnostic)
4. **PSD_monitor** (PSD_mon_source) - 2D position-sensitive monitor after source (diagnostic)
5. **Collimator_linear** (SC1) - Soller collimator (conditional on ALF1 && BET1)
6. **Arm** (Guide_out) - Reference point at monochromator entrance
7. **Monochromator_curved** (Monochromator) - Curved mosaic crystal monochromator
8. **Powder1** (Sample) - Powder sample with scattering vector QM
9. **Monochromator_curved** (Analyzer) - Curved mosaic crystal analyzer
10. **L_monitor** (L_mon_analyzer) - Wavelength monitor after analyzer (diagnostic)
11. **PSD_monitor** (PSD_mon_analyzer) - 2D position-sensitive monitor after analyzer (diagnostic)
12. **Monitor** (Detector) - Final detector
